# The @@project_id system variable
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/system-variables
#
# The first script creates the dataset unverified_project_id, which the single statements after it
# define a view and a function in. The dataset stays in the project after the queries run.

# Whether system variable names are case-insensitive.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_project_id;
SELECT @@PROJECT_ID = @@project_id
?>

# BigQuery's error for a view or function that a single statement, rather than a script, defines
# with a system variable.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW unverified_project_id.v AS SELECT @@project_id AS project_id
?>

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION unverified_project_id.f() AS (@@project_id)
?>

# BigQuery's error for an assignment to the read-only @@project_id.

SET @@project_id = 'example-project';
SELECT 1
?>
